name: @headwaters-ai/cli
description: hwai: the Headwaters CLI. Compile faces from source texts, ask them what they would do with Maestro, and build states
author: Headwaters Lab Inc.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && oclif manifest && oclif readme

account.description: Your account: sign in, plan, credits, cards, connections and preferences

face.description: Faces: create, compile, list, share, publish and manage them

face:compile.description: Compile source material into a face: documents and threads

face:doc.description: A face's documents: create, compile, edit, pause, reset and delete

face:thread.description: A face's threads: create, compile, edit, replace, pause, reset and delete

face:avatar.description: A face's picture: list, get, make, upload and delete

face:style.description: Build and manage a face's styles

face:fidelity.description: Fidelity runs: start, turn, pick, read and save

face:benchmark.description: Compare a face against a reference model on its own material

maestro.description: Maestro, stateless: choices, decide and chat. --face @owner~face; maestro-1 by default, --fast for maestro-1-fast

state.description: States: the proof in progress your agent builds, kept on the server: goals, their refinement, tests and claims. Every node is a premise, named by its key. state:create --use makes one for this directory

group.description: Groups of faces that work together

models.description: The models you can name, with their prices

user.description: Other users: profiles, followers and following
